C1278.title: Ministry of Public Security Exposes Fake Websites Used for Fraudulent Certifications and Counterfeit Documents
C1278.summary: In June 2026, the cybersecurity division of China's Ministry of Public Security disclosed that criminals have been operating counterfeit official websites to conduct fraudulent certifications, produce fake documents, commit online fraud, and steal personal information. Law enforcement authorities have investigated and handled a number of cases involving the creation of such spoofed sites.

references.title: Ministry of Public Security Reveals: Offenders Set Up Fake Websites for Fraudulent Certification and Fake Document Production
